connectors.name: Freedom in the World (FIW)
connectors.coverageSummary: Annual global democracy assessment evaluating Political Rights (0–40) and Civil Liberties (0–60) across 54 African countries and contested territories.

connectors.name: Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI)
connectors.coverageSummary: Six aggregate governance dimensions: Voice and Accountability, Political Stability, Government Effectiveness, Regulatory Quality, Rule of Law, and Control of Corruption.

connectors.name: Africa Integrity Indicators (AII)
connectors.coverageSummary: Assesses in-practice integrity mechanisms, judicial independence, audit transparency, and public procurement oversight across all 54 African states.

connectors.name: World Bank Gender Statistics
connectors.coverageSummary: Disaggregated indicators on female economic opportunities, maternal healthcare, parliamentary representation, and Women, Business & the Law (WBL) indices.

connectors.name: World Bank Group Corporate Scorecard
connectors.coverageSummary: Results-based development impact metrics: climate resilience provisioning, private capital mobilization, crisis preparedness, and employment generation.

connectors.name: Gender & Social Accountability Platform (GSAP)
connectors.coverageSummary: Community oversight, citizen scorecards in health and primary education, and local public grievance redress performance.

connectors.name: Social Protection & Labor Database (SPID)
connectors.coverageSummary: Social safety net coverage, cash transfer recipients, active labor market program participation, and shock-responsive social assistance.

connectors.name: Global Health Observatory (GHO)
connectors.coverageSummary: Universal health coverage (UHC) index, physician and nursing density, premature NCD mortality, tuberculosis and malaria incidence.

connectors.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)
connectors.coverageSummary: Learning poverty rates, out-of-school populations, pupil-to-trained-teacher ratios, and female/male STEM university graduates.

connectors.name: Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP)
connectors.coverageSummary: Dynamic international poverty line measurements ($2.15, $3.65, $6.85 2017 PPP), Poverty Gap, Palma Ratio, and Shared Prosperity metrics.

connectors.name: Atlas of Social Protection (ASPIRE)
connectors.coverageSummary: Adequacy of social assistance transfers, benefit incidence among the poorest 20% quintile, and formal social insurance participation.

connectors.name: International Debt Statistics (IDS)
connectors.coverageSummary: External public and publicly guaranteed (PPG) debt stocks, debt service to export ratios, concessional creditor share, and PV of debt to GNI.

connectors.name: UN Comtrade Database
connectors.coverageSummary: Bilateral merchandise trade flows, intra-African AfCFTA trade volumes, agricultural trade balances, and commodity export diversification.

connectors.name: IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO)
connectors.coverageSummary: Multi-year macroeconomic forecasts: real GDP growth, general government gross debt % of GDP, current account balance, and consumer price inflation.

connectors.name: Country Policy & Institutional Assessment (CPIA)
connectors.coverageSummary: IDA allocation assessment (scale 1–6): Economic Management, Structural Policies, Policies for Social Inclusion/Equity, and Public Sector Management.

connectors.name: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (CCKP)
connectors.coverageSummary: High-resolution CMIP6 climate anomaly pathways, historical precipitation variability, ND-GAIN vulnerability indices, and renewable capacity shares.

connectors.name: Africa Knowledge Platform (AKP 241 Datasets)
connectors.coverageSummary: European Commission JRC Master Registry of 241 spatial and statistical datasets spanning 5 thematic pillars: Demographics & Health, Energy & Telecom, Environment & Climate, Agriculture & Water, and Macroeconomics across all 54 African states.

indicators.name: Freedom in the World Total Score (0-100)
indicators.label: Freedom in the World Score
indicators.definition: Composite democracy score evaluating political rights (0-40) and civil liberties (0-60) from Freedom House.

indicators.name: Political Rights Score (0-40)
indicators.label: Political Rights Rating
indicators.definition: Assesses electoral process, political pluralism and participation, and functioning of government.

indicators.name: Civil Liberties Score (0-60)
indicators.label: Civil Liberties Rating
indicators.definition: Evaluates freedom of expression and belief, associational rights, rule of law, and personal autonomy.

indicators.name: Freedom Status Category Score
indicators.label: Freedom Status Code
indicators.definition: Status classification: 3 = Free (scores >= 70), 2 = Partly Free (scores 35-69), 1 = Not Free (scores < 35).

indicators.name: Voice and Accountability Percentile Rank
indicators.label: Voice & Accountability
indicators.definition: Reflects perceptions of the extent to which a country citizens are able to participate in selecting their government, freedom of expression, association, and media.

indicators.name: Political Stability & Absence of Violence Percentile Rank
indicators.label: Political Stability
indicators.definition: Measures perceptions of the likelihood of political instability and/or politically-motivated violence, including terrorism.

indicators.name: Government Effectiveness Percentile Rank
indicators.label: Government Effectiveness
indicators.definition: Reflects perceptions of the quality of public services, civil service independence from political pressures, and policy implementation credibility.

indicators.name: Regulatory Quality Percentile Rank
indicators.label: Regulatory Quality
indicators.definition: Reflects perceptions of the ability of the government to formulate and implement sound policies and regulations that permit private sector development.

indicators.name: Rule of Law Percentile Rank
indicators.label: Rule of Law
indicators.definition: Perceptions of confidence in society rules, contract enforcement, property rights, police, and courts.

indicators.name: Control of Corruption Percentile Rank
indicators.label: Control of Corruption
indicators.definition: Perceptions of the extent to which public power is exercised for private gain, including petty and grand corruption.

indicators.name: AII Rule of Law & Accountability Score
indicators.label: AII Rule of Law
indicators.definition: In-practice assessment of judicial accountability, citizen protections, and executive oversight mechanisms.

indicators.name: AII Public Management & Budget Transparency
indicators.label: AII Budget Transparency
indicators.definition: Open budget execution, procurement tracking, and supreme audit institution effectiveness.

indicators.name: AII Anti-Corruption Enforcement Score
indicators.label: AII Anti-Corruption
indicators.definition: Operational autonomy, investigation capacity, and prosecution rates of national anti-corruption bodies.

indicators.name: Women, Business and the Law Index Score (0-100)
indicators.label: WBL Legal Equality Index
indicators.definition: World Bank index measuring laws and regulations that affect women economic opportunities across 8 dimensions.

indicators.name: Female Labor Force Participation Rate (% of Female Pop 15+)
indicators.label: Female Labor Participation
indicators.definition: The proportion of the female population ages 15 and older that is economically active.

indicators.name: Proportion of Seats Held by Women in National Parliaments (%)
indicators.label: Women in Parliament
indicators.definition: Percentage of parliamentary seats in single or lower chambers occupied by women.

indicators.name: Gross Secondary School Enrollment, Female to Male Ratio (%)
indicators.label: Female/Male Secondary Ratio
indicators.definition: Ratio of female gross enrollment rate for secondary education to male gross enrollment rate.

indicators.name: People Provided with Climate-Resilient Infrastructure / Services
indicators.label: Climate-Resilient Beneficiaries
indicators.definition: Number of people benefiting from WBG-supported climate-resilient water, transport, and energy systems.

indicators.name: Private Capital Mobilized / Facilitated for Development
indicators.label: Private Capital Mobilized
indicators.definition: Total commercial private financing mobilized through multilateral guarantees, syndications, and blend finance.

indicators.name: National Crisis Preparedness & Early Warning Readiness Score
indicators.label: Crisis Preparedness Score
indicators.definition: Institutional readiness to forecast, absorb, and respond to epidemiological, climatic, or macroeconomic shocks.

indicators.name: Direct & Indirect Jobs Created or Supported Through Programs
indicators.label: Jobs Supported
indicators.definition: Total formal and SME employment generated through active development operations and guarantee facilities.

indicators.name: Citizen Engagement in Public Service Delivery Score
indicators.label: Citizen Engagement Score
indicators.definition: Institutionalization of citizen feedback loops and participatory budget consultations in public administration.

indicators.name: Community-Based Health Facility Oversight Rate (% of Clinics)
indicators.label: Community Health Oversight
indicators.definition: Share of primary healthcare centers with active local health management committees including community representatives.

indicators.name: Public Service Grievance Redress Resolution Rate (%)
indicators.label: Grievance Redress Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of registered citizen complaints and service delivery grievances resolved within official statutory time limits.

indicators.name: Social Safety Net (SSN) Population Coverage Rate (%)
indicators.label: Social Safety Net Coverage
indicators.definition: Percentage of the national population covered by at least one non-contributory social safety net program.

indicators.name: Active Labor Market Program (ALMP) Participation (% of Labor)
indicators.label: Labor Program Participation
indicators.definition: Share of unemployed and underemployed youth engaged in vocational skills training, public works, or wage subsidy schemes.

indicators.name: Cash Transfer Beneficiaries in Extreme Poverty Quintile (%)
indicators.label: Cash Transfer Coverage
indicators.definition: Percentage of extreme poor households receiving regular cash transfers (conditional or unconditional).

indicators.name: Universal Health Coverage (UHC) Service Coverage Index (0-100)
indicators.label: UHC Service Coverage Index
indicators.definition: WHO index (SDG 3.8.1) measuring coverage of essential health services across reproductive, maternal, child health, infectious and NCDs.

indicators.name: Premature Mortality Rate from Major NCDs (Ages 30-70, %)
indicators.label: Premature NCD Mortality
indicators.definition: Probability (%) of dying between age 30 and exact age 70 from cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, or chronic respiratory disease.

indicators.name: Physician and Medical Doctor Density (per 10,000 People)
indicators.label: Physician Density
indicators.definition: Total number of practicing physicians per 10,000 population recorded by national health workforce registries.

indicators.name: Nursing & Midwifery Personnel Density (per 10,000 People)
indicators.label: Nursing & Midwife Density
indicators.definition: Number of practicing nurses and midwives per 10,000 population.

indicators.name: Malaria Incidence per 1,000 Population at Risk
indicators.label: Malaria Incidence
indicators.definition: Estimated number of malaria cases per 1,000 population at risk per year.

indicators.name: Learning Poverty Rate (% Children Unable to Read by Age 10)
indicators.label: Learning Poverty Rate
indicators.definition: Share of children who are unable to read and understand a simple text by age 10 (UNESCO / World Bank baseline).

indicators.name: Out-of-School Children Rate (Primary School Age, %)
indicators.label: Primary Out-of-School Rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of primary-school-age children who are not enrolled in primary or secondary school.

indicators.name: Tertiary Graduates in STEM Fields (% of Total Graduates)
indicators.label: STEM Graduate Share
indicators.definition: Percentage of tertiary education graduates in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.

indicators.name: Pupil-to-Trained Teacher Ratio in Primary Education
indicators.label: Pupil-Trained Teacher Ratio
indicators.definition: Average number of pupils per trained teacher in primary education.

indicators.name: Poverty Headcount at $2.15/Day (2017 PPP) (% of Population)
indicators.label: Extreme Poverty ($2.15/day)
indicators.definition: Percentage of the population living on less than $2.15 a day at 2017 international purchasing power parity prices.

indicators.name: Poverty Headcount at $3.65/Day (2017 PPP) (% of Population)
indicators.label: Lower-Middle Poverty ($3.65/day)
indicators.definition: Percentage of the population living on less than $3.65 a day (LMIC benchmark).

indicators.name: Poverty Headcount at $6.85/Day (2017 PPP) (% of Population)
indicators.label: Upper-Middle Poverty ($6.85/day)
indicators.definition: Percentage of the population living on less than $6.85 a day (UMIC benchmark).

indicators.name: Poverty Gap Index at $2.15 a Day (%)
indicators.label: Poverty Gap ($2.15)
indicators.definition: Mean shortfall in income or consumption from the $2.15/day poverty line expressed as a percentage of the line.

indicators.name: Palma Ratio (Top 10% / Bottom 40% Income Share)
indicators.label: Palma Inequality Ratio
indicators.definition: Ratio of the richest 10% of the population share of gross national income divided by the poorest 40% share.

indicators.name: Adequacy of Social Assistance (% of Beneficiary Total Welfare)
indicators.label: Social Assistance Adequacy
indicators.definition: Total transfer amount received by all beneficiaries in a population group as a share of their total income/expenditure.

indicators.name: Benefit Incidence of Safety Nets in Poorest 20% Quintile (%)
indicators.label: Safety Net Q1 Targeting
indicators.definition: Percentage of total social assistance transfers that go to the poorest 20% quintile of the population.

indicators.name: Social Insurance Coverage of Formal & Contributory Workers (%)
indicators.label: Social Insurance Coverage
indicators.definition: Percentage of the active labor force participating in contributory pension and health insurance schemes.

indicators.name: External Debt Stocks, Public & Publicly Guaranteed (PPG, USD B)
indicators.label: PPG External Debt Stock
indicators.definition: Total external long-term public and publicly guaranteed debt stock owed to non-resident creditors.

indicators.name: PPG Debt Service (% of Exports of Goods & Services)
indicators.label: Debt Service-to-Exports
indicators.definition: Public and publicly guaranteed debt service (principal and interest) expressed as a percentage of total exports.

indicators.name: Concessional Debt Share (% of Total External Debt)
indicators.label: Concessional Debt Share
indicators.definition: Concessional loans convey a grant element of at least 35% (IDA, ADF, bilateral concession).

indicators.name: Present Value of External Debt (% of GNI)
indicators.label: PV of Debt to GNI
indicators.definition: Present value of total external debt discounted at market interest rates divided by Gross National Income.

indicators.name: Intra-African Bilateral Trade Volume (USD Billion)
indicators.label: Intra-African Trade Volume
indicators.definition: Total value of merchandise trade conducted between African continental trade partners under AfCFTA agreements.

indicators.name: Agricultural Merchandise Trade Balance (USD Million)
indicators.label: Agri Trade Balance
indicators.definition: Net trade balance (Exports minus Imports) for food, livestock, and agricultural raw materials (SITC 0 + 1 + 22 + 4).

indicators.name: High-Technology & Manufactured Exports Share (% of Exports)
indicators.label: High-Tech Export Share
indicators.definition: Products with high R&D intensity (aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, scientific instruments, electrical machinery).

indicators.name: UNCTAD Trade Product Diversification Index (0-1)
indicators.label: Trade Diversification Index
indicators.definition: Measures the absolute deviation of the country trade structure from the world structure (0 = highly diversified, 1 = concentrated).

indicators.name: IMF Real GDP Growth Forecast 2025-2026 (%)
indicators.label: GDP Growth Forecast
indicators.definition: IMF staff medium-term projected real gross domestic product annual growth rate.

indicators.name: General Government Gross Debt (% of GDP)
indicators.label: Gov Gross Debt (% GDP)
indicators.definition: Gross debt consists of all liabilities that require payment or payments of interest and/or principal by the debtor.

indicators.name: Current Account Balance (% of GDP)
indicators.label: Current Account Balance
indicators.definition: Current account balance expressed as a percentage of GDP in US dollars.

indicators.name: Inflation Rate, Average Consumer Prices (%)
indicators.label: Average CPI Inflation
indicators.definition: Year-on-year average change in the Consumer Price Index calculated by IMF staff.

indicators.name: CPIA Overall Composite Rating (1=Low to 6=High)
indicators.label: CPIA Overall Score
indicators.definition: Average score of the four CPIA clusters evaluating policy framework and institutional capacity for poverty reduction.

indicators.name: CPIA Economic Management Cluster Score (1-6)
indicators.label: CPIA Economic Management
indicators.definition: Includes monetary and exchange rate policy, fiscal policy, and debt policy management rating.

indicators.name: CPIA Structural Policies Cluster Score (1-6)
indicators.label: CPIA Structural Policies
indicators.definition: Includes trade policy, financial sector soundness, and business regulatory environment.

indicators.name: CPIA Social Inclusion & Equity Cluster Score (1-6)
indicators.label: CPIA Social Inclusion
indicators.definition: Includes gender equality, equity of public resource use, building human resources, and social protection.

indicators.name: CPIA Public Sector Management & Institutions Score (1-6)
indicators.label: CPIA Public Sector Mgt
indicators.definition: Property rights, quality of budgetary and financial management, efficiency of revenue mobilization, public administration, and transparency.

indicators.name: Projected Mean Annual Temperature Anomaly by 2050 (°C)
indicators.label: Projected Warming (+°C)
indicators.definition: Projected average temperature increase (°C) relative to 1995-2014 reference period under SSP2-4.5 pathway from CMIP6 models.

indicators.name: Historical Precipitation Variability Index (%)
indicators.label: Precipitation Variability
indicators.definition: Coefficient of variation in historical annual rainfall totals over 1980-2023 determining drought and flood vulnerability.

indicators.name: ND-GAIN Country Climate Vulnerability Score (0-100)
indicators.label: Climate Vulnerability (ND-GAIN)
indicators.definition: Notre Dame Global Adaptation Initiative vulnerability score measuring exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity to climate disruption.

indicators.name: Renewable Energy Share in Total Installed Capacity (%)
indicators.label: Renewable Capacity Share
indicators.definition: Share of hydro, solar, wind, and geothermal in national grid-connected electrical generation capacity.
